latest.summary: Our honeypots use "Cowrie" to collect SSH data. With the emergence of the "sshole" vulnerability last week, we are now seeing an increase in attempts to exploit the vulnerability. Our data is a bit limited in this respect. Our honeypots collect only the first 255 characters of SSH passwords. Longer passwords are highly unusual and not used for the usual password brute-forcing we observe.

hottest.title: 約10年間見逃されていたOpenSSHの脆弱性「*sshole」が発覚、257文字以上のパスワードでログイン禁止アカウントを突破可能に

I suspect this is for CVE-2023-20198.
